name: Factorial
tagline: Factorial is an all-in-one HR platform for small and medium businesses covering time tracking, payroll, documents, performance reviews, and recruitment. Its AI features include automated payroll processing, AI-powered offer letter generation, and employee sentiment analysis from pulse surveys.
